title: josenimo/histo pipeline - params.input_cycle schema
description: One row per acquisition cycle. Rows sharing a sample name are grouped and ordered by cycle_number before stitching. Derived from nf-core/mcmicro's schema_input_cycle.json.

sample.description: Sample name. Becomes meta.id and is used to group cycles and to name outputs.
sample.errorMessage: sample must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen

cycle_number.description: 1-based acquisition cycle. Determines the order in which cycles are passed to Ashlar, and must match the cycle_number column of the marker sheet.
cycle_number.errorMessage: cycle_number must be an integer of 1 or greater, sequential and without gaps

image_tiles.description: Path to the raw image tiles for this cycle: either a single multi-tile file or a directory of tiles.
image_tiles.errorMessage: image_tiles must be an existing path without spaces

dfp.description: Optional pre-computed dark-field profile for this cycle. Supply only when skipping BaSiCPy; if given for one cycle it must be given for all.
dfp.errorMessage: dfp must be an existing file without spaces

ffp.description: Optional pre-computed flat-field profile for this cycle. Supply only when skipping BaSiCPy; if given for one cycle it must be given for all.
ffp.errorMessage: ffp must be an existing file without spaces

marker_sheet.description: Path to the marker sheet for this sample, one row per channel. Every cycle row of a sample must name the same file: the sheet describes the whole stitched image, not one cycle of it. Two samples may name different sheets, which is the point of the column.
marker_sheet.errorMessage: marker_sheet must be an existing .csv file without spaces
